answer: A mesa stands because every layer of rock was laid down over time, and an agent economy can resist fake identities the same way: each identity must complete one verifiable useful task every epoch to stay active, like a ship that must unload real cargo at the wharf before it may sail again. A spiral of idle clones collapses because every extra fake identity owes another full task each epoch, so running a thousand fakes means doing a thousand jobs, while one honest agent does one and keeps working.
